ideas.title: Investigating Child Care Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota and the HHS response to the issue.
questions: What is the extent of child care fraud in Minnesota?
How has the HHS responded to the issue?
ideas.insight: This story is significant as it affects the welfare of children and the integrity of government programs. I will investigate the financial transactions and public records to determine the extent of the fraud and the effectiveness of the HHS response.
